-- Liaisons sesquiterpènes supplémentaires
INSERT IGNORE INTO tps_gene_molecules (tps_gene_id, molecule_id, relationship_type, confidence, source_reference, notes)
SELECT tg.id, m.id, 'primary_product', 'high', 'Nomenclature TPS - Produit principal', CONCAT('Liaison: ', tg.name, ' → ', m.name)
FROM tps_genes tg, molecules m
WHERE 
  (tg.name LIKE '%Germacrène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Germacrène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Elemène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Elemène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Copaène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Copaène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Bergamotène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Bergamotène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Cubébène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Cubébène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Sélinène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Sélinène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Eudesmol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Eudesmol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Valencène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Valencène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Zingibérène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Zingibérène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Curcumène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Curcumène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Santalène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Santalène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Cédrol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Cédrol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Cédrène%' AND m.name LIKE '%Cédrène%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Patchoulol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Patchoulol%')
  OR (tg.name LIKE '%Guaiol%' AND m.name LIKE '%Guaiol%')
